programs.title: Prince of Persia
programs.subtitle: Apple II, 1989
programs.author: Jordan Mechner
programs.description: The game that invented cinematic platformers — built by one developer over four years on Apple II hardware with 128K of RAM. The source code was recovered in 2012 from 22-year-old floppy disks.

files.title: SOUND.S
files.description: The complete sound engine — twenty sounds, one speaker, zero compromises

files.title: BOOT.S
files.description: The two-stage disk boot loader with 128K memory check

files.title: SEQTABLE.S
files.description: The animation state machine — every movement rotoscoped from film

files.title: MASTER.S
files.description: Game flow controller: boot, attract mode, save/load, level sequencing
